description: Arrêts de bus is a dataset listed in Ville de Meudon open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Seine Ouest. Localisation des arrêts de bus sur Meudon. Coverage: Meudon. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements, Mobilité. Its keywords are Meudon, Arrêts de bus, bus, arrets. The portal shows 104 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-meudon-fr-portal.
